title: Counter-evidence — Neon Koi (challenger claim)
report: The challenger 0xcf143E59b3C09c7DF374BE488036A0b375CEdb7A claims to be the creator of 'Neon Koi'. The counter-evidence shows only that the challenger posted an image resembling 'Neon Koi' on 2026-10-20, eighteen days after the registered creator's first publication. No creation date for the challenger is stated. No signed message from the challenger is provided. No earlier publication is shown. The counter-evidence does not prove the challenger created the work, and does not prove creation earlier than 2026-10-01.
